mnemonic.meaning: 破 has 石 (stone): a stone smashing through. It tears or breaks.
mnemonic.reading: "YABU-RE-RU!" (やぶれる) A thorny bush (藪, やぶ) rips your jeans.

examples.ja: 釘に引っかけて服が破れた。
examples.en: My clothes ripped when they caught on a nail.

items.note: Intransitive (it tears). 破る = you tear it, or break a rule. 敗れる (also やぶれる) = to be defeated.

mnemonic.meaning: 不 not + 利 advantage: no advantage.
mnemonic.reading: "FOO, REE!" (ふり) Phew, really bad odds.

examples.ja: 雨の日の試合は私たちに不利だ。
examples.en: A match on a rainy day is to our disadvantage.

items.note: Opposite of 有利 (Level 11).

mnemonic.meaning: 嗅 has 口 (mouth) and 臭 (smell): sniffing with your face.
mnemonic.reading: "KAGU!" (かぐ) Same sound as 家具 (furniture). You sniff the furniture.

examples.ja: 犬が地面の匂いを嗅いでいる。
examples.en: The dog is sniffing the ground.

items.note: You do the smelling. Something that gives off a smell is 匂う / 臭う.

mnemonic.meaning: 陰 has 阝 (hill): the shady side of a hill.
mnemonic.reading: "KAGE!" (かげ) Same sound as 影 (shadow, silhouette).

examples.ja: 木の陰で休んだ。
examples.en: I rested in the shade of a tree.

items.note: 陰 = shade, a hidden place. 影 = a cast shadow or silhouette. 陰で = behind someone's back.

mnemonic.meaning: 説 has 言 (words): words that explain. A theory.
mnemonic.reading: "SETSU!" (せつ) Same せつ as 説明 (explanation).

examples.ja: この現象にはいくつかの説がある。
examples.en: There are several theories about this phenomenon.

items.note: 一説によると = according to one theory.

mnemonic.meaning: 職 has 耳 (ear): listening to orders at work.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOKU!" (しょく) A shock: you lost your job.

examples.ja: 彼は先月、職を失った。
examples.en: He lost his job last month.

items.note: 職 is formal. 仕事 is everyday. 職業 = occupation, 就職 = getting a job.

mnemonic.meaning: 意 mind + 地 nature: the nature of your mind. Stubborn will.
mnemonic.reading: "EE, JEE!" (いじ) Same sound as 維持 (maintenance). Easy to keep your pride.

examples.ja: 意地を張らないで、謝りなさい。
examples.en: Don't be stubborn. Just apologise.

items.note: 意地を張る = to be stubborn. 意地悪 = mean, spiteful.

mnemonic.meaning: 芝 lawn + 居 be: being on the lawn. Long ago, audiences sat on the lawn to watch performances.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIBA, EE!" (しばい) A shiba dog in a play.

examples.ja: 昨日、友達と芝居を見に行った。
examples.en: I went to see a play with a friend yesterday.

items.note: Also pretending: それは芝居だ (that's an act).

mnemonic.meaning: 群 has 羊 (sheep): a flock of sheep.
mnemonic.reading: "GUN!" (ぐん) A gun scatters the herd.

examples.ja: 彼の成績はクラスでも群を抜いている。
examples.en: His grades stand out even in his class.

items.note: On its own it's usually 群れ (むれ, a flock or herd). ぐん appears in 群を抜く (to stand out from the rest) and compounds like 群衆 (crowd).

mnemonic.meaning: 振 has 扌 (hand): a hand swinging.
mnemonic.reading: "FURI!" (ふり) Same sound as 不利. A free swing.

examples.ja: 彼は聞こえない振りをした。
examples.en: He pretended not to hear.

items.note: 〜振りをする = pretend (often in kana: ふり). 久しぶり uses ぶり: after a long time.

mnemonic.meaning: 高 high + 速 fast: high speed.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, SOKU!" (こうそく) Same sound as 拘束 (restraint, Level 9).

examples.ja: 高速で一時間ほど走った。
examples.en: We drove about an hour on the expressway.

items.note: Short for 高速道路 (expressway). 高速バス = highway bus.

mnemonic.meaning: 瓶 has 瓦 (pottery): a pottery container.
mnemonic.reading: "BIN!" (びん) Put the bottle in the bin.

examples.ja: 空き瓶を捨てた。
examples.en: I threw away the empty bottles.

items.note: Glass bottles. Plastic ones are ペットボトル.

mnemonic.meaning: 段 = steps cut into a hillside.
mnemonic.reading: "DAN!" (だん) Dan climbs the steps. Same だん as 階段.

examples.ja: 一段ずつ階段を上った。
examples.en: I climbed the stairs one step at a time.

items.note: Also ranks in martial arts and go: 三段 (third dan).

mnemonic.meaning: 劣 = 少 (few) + 力 (power): less power. Worse.
mnemonic.reading: "OTORU!" (おとる) Oh, toll road's worse.

examples.ja: 品質では他社に劣らない。
examples.en: In quality we're as good as the other companies.

items.note: Often 〜に劣らない = not inferior to. 優れる is the opposite.

mnemonic.meaning: 泡 has 氵 (water): water wrapped (包) around air.
mnemonic.reading: "AWA!" (あわ) Awa, a foamy bubble.

examples.ja: ビールの泡がこぼれた。
examples.en: The beer foam spilled over.

items.note: 泡を食う = to be flustered.

mnemonic.meaning: 衝 collide + 突 thrust: crash into each other.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOU, TOTSU!" (しょうとつ) Show-tots crash on stage.

examples.ja: 車と車が正面衝突した。
examples.en: Two cars collided head-on.

items.note: Also arguments: 意見が衝突する.

mnemonic.meaning: 紐 has 糸 (thread): a thick thread. A string.
mnemonic.reading: "HEE, MO!" (ひも) He moves the string.

examples.ja: 靴の紐がほどけているよ。
examples.en: Your shoelace is untied.

items.note: ひも is also slang for a man who lives off his partner.

mnemonic.meaning: SURE (brush) + 違 differ: brushing past going different ways.
mnemonic.reading: SURE + CHIGAU: brush past, going different ways. (すれちがう)

examples.ja: 駅で昔の友達とすれ違った。
examples.en: I passed an old friend at the station.

items.note: Also for misunderstandings: 気持ちがすれ違う.

mnemonic.meaning: 遭 has ⻌ (road): something you run into on the road.
mnemonic.reading: "AU!" (あう) Same sound as 会う. You meet trouble.

examples.ja: 帰り道で事故に遭った。
examples.en: I was in an accident on the way home.

items.note: Only for bad things: 事故に遭う, ひどい目に遭う. Often written 会う in casual text.

mnemonic.meaning: 友 friend + 情 feeling: the feeling between friends.
mnemonic.reading: "YOU, JOE!" (ゆうじょう) You and Joe are friends.

examples.ja: 二人の友情は今も続いている。
examples.en: Their friendship continues to this day.

items.note: 友情 = the bond itself. 友達 = the person.

mnemonic.meaning: 章 = 音 (sound) + 十 (ten): ten sounds make a chapter of music.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOU!" (しょう) The show's first chapter.

examples.ja: この本は十の章に分かれている。
examples.en: This book is divided into ten chapters.

items.note: 第一章 = chapter one. Also badges: 勲章 (medal).

mnemonic.meaning: 裂 has 衣 (cloth): cloth being torn apart.
mnemonic.reading: "SAKU!" (さく) Same sound as 咲く (bloom). The fabric splits open like a flower.

examples.ja: 布を二つに裂いた。
examples.en: I tore the cloth in two.

items.note: Figurative: 時間を割く (make time) uses 割く, also さく.

mnemonic.meaning: SOKO (there) + DE (at): at that point, and so...

examples.ja: 道に迷った。そこで、地図を見ることにした。
examples.en: I got lost. So I decided to look at a map.

items.note: Introduces what you did in response. Also literally "there": そこで待って.

mnemonic.meaning: 収 collect + 穫 harvest: gathering in the crops.
mnemonic.reading: "SHUU, KAKU!" (しゅうかく) Shoes (シュー) carry the harvest.

examples.ja: 秋は米の収穫の季節だ。
examples.en: Autumn is the season for harvesting rice.

items.note: Also results from effort: 今日の会議は収穫があった (today's meeting was fruitful).

mnemonic.meaning: 急 sudden + 速 fast: suddenly fast.
mnemonic.reading: "KYUU, SOKU!" (きゅうそく) Cute (キュー) socks go fast. Same sound as 休息 (rest).

examples.ja: 町は急速に発展した。
examples.en: The town developed rapidly.

items.note: Formal. Usually 急速に.

mnemonic.meaning: 金 money + 額 amount: amount of money.
mnemonic.reading: "KIN, GAKU!" (きんがく) The king's cash amount.

examples.ja: 請求書の金額を確認した。
examples.en: I checked the amount on the invoice.

items.note: Neutral. 額 alone also means forehead or a picture frame.

mnemonic.meaning: 通 pass + 過 pass: pass through.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUU, KA!" (つうか) Two cars pass through. Same sound as 通貨 (currency).

examples.ja: この電車は次の駅を通過します。
examples.en: This train will pass through the next station without stopping.

items.note: Also passing an exam stage or a bill: 法案が通過する.

mnemonic.meaning: 演 perform + 奏 play music: performing music.
mnemonic.reading: "EN, SOU!" (えんそう) Hen sews while the band plays.

examples.ja: ピアノの演奏を聞きに行った。
examples.en: I went to hear a piano performance.

items.note: Only for music. A play is 演劇 or 芝居.

mnemonic.meaning: 澄 has 氵 (water): water so clear you can see the bottom.
mnemonic.reading: "SUMU!" (すむ) Same sound as 住む (live) and 済む (finish).

examples.ja: 山の空気は澄んでいる。
examples.en: The mountain air is clear.

items.note: For water, air, sounds and eyes. 澄んだ声 = a clear voice.

mnemonic.meaning: 信 believe + 仰 look up to: believing in and looking up to something.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIN, KOU!" (しんこう) Shin goes to the temple: faith. Same sound as 進行 (progress).

examples.ja: 彼女は深い信仰を持っている。
examples.en: She has a deep religious faith.

items.note: Religious belief. 信用 / 信頼 are trust in people.
